solution.p: The interval notation tells us to graph all numbers between -1 and \infty\text{.} So the shading can start at -1 and go all the way to the right to \infty. There should be a parenthesis at -1 to indicate that -1 itself is not included.
We have shaded all numbers greater than -1\text{.} So in set-builder notation, the interval is {\{ x \mid x > -1 \}}\text{.}
